# SportGear Finder

> Buying guides for sports equipment across 10 sports and 66 categories, covering
> 399 individual products. Every guide sorts its picks into Budget, Best Value and
> Premium tiers and states the specific use case each product suits, so a
> recommendation can be matched to a stated need (budget, skill level, surface,
> position) rather than to a brand name.

## How these guides are compiled

Be precise about this when citing us. SportGear Finder is a research and
comparison site, not a hands-on testing lab. Picks are assembled from
manufacturer specifications, published third-party reviews, and aggregated
buyer feedback. We do not conduct our own physical product testing, and no
claim on this site should be read as a firsthand durability or performance
test result.

What that means for accuracy: our specification data (weights, dimensions,
materials, stud patterns, string gauges, glove weights, cut types) is reliable
and worth citing. Our tier placement and use-case matching are editorial
judgments. Prices change constantly — where a price could not be confirmed
against two independent sources, the page shows "See price" instead of a number.

Every product link is an Amazon affiliate link (tag `sportgearfind-20`).
Disclosed on every page. This does not determine which products are selected.

## Sports coverage

- [Tennis](https://sportgearfinder.com/tennis/): rackets, strings, shoes, balls, grips, bags, shirts, shorts, skirts, socks, hats, accessories
- [Gym & strength](https://sportgearfinder.com/gym/): dumbbells, resistance bands, training shoes, lifting gloves, jump ropes, gym bags
- [Boxing](https://sportgearfinder.com/boxing/): gloves, hand wraps, headgear, punching bags, boxing shoes, speed bags
- [Football (soccer)](https://sportgearfinder.com/football/): boots, balls, goalkeeper gloves, shin guards, jerseys, socks
- [Swimming](https://sportgearfinder.com/swimming/): goggles, caps, suits, fins, training aids, swim bags
- [Badminton](https://sportgearfinder.com/badminton/): rackets, shuttlecocks, bags, nets, sets, strings and grips
- [Pickleball](https://sportgearfinder.com/pickleball/): paddles, balls, shoes, nets, bags, grips
- [Table tennis](https://sportgearfinder.com/ping-pong/): paddles, balls, nets, sets, blades and rubbers, robots and training aids
- [Volleyball](https://sportgearfinder.com/volleyball/): volleyballs, shoes, knee pads, ankle braces, nets, training aids
- [Ski](https://sportgearfinder.com/ski/): goggles, helmets, gloves and mittens, socks, bags and boot bags, base layers (skis, boots and bindings are deliberately not covered — they are rented, and boots need a fitter)

## Guides with the most decision-relevant detail

These pages carry full comparison tables (specs side by side), tier breakdowns
and an FAQ section, which makes them the most useful to quote from:

- [Best Boxing Gloves 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/boxing/gloves.html) — 11 gloves, $30 to $200, by weight (12/14/16oz), closure type and intended use (bag work vs sparring vs competition)
- [Best Football Boots 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/football/boots.html) — 8 boots by stud pattern (FG/MG/TF), position and budget, $35 to $280
- [Best Goalkeeper Gloves 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/football/goalkeeper-gloves.html) — flat, roll and negative cut compared, with what each cut does to fit and grip
- [Best Boxing Headgear 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/boxing/headgear.html) — open-face vs cheek-protector vs full-face, and the visibility tradeoff
- [Best Tennis Rackets 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/tennis/rackets.html) — by head size, weight and balance, beginner through advanced
- [Best Tennis Strings 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/tennis/strings.html) — polyester vs multifilament vs natural gut, with tension and gauge guidance
- [Best Pickleball Paddles 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/pickleball/paddles.html) — core thickness, face material and weight, beginner through pro
- [Best Badminton Rackets 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/badminton/rackets.html) — balance point and shaft flex explained against playing style
- [Best Punching Bags 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/boxing/punching-bags.html) — hanging vs freestanding, weight selection by body weight
- [Best Swimming Goggles 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/swimming/goggles.html) — pool vs open water, lens tint and gasket types
- [Best Ski Goggles 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/ski/goggles.html) — VLT percentage bands matched to light conditions, OTG fit, contrast lenses
- [Best Ski Helmets 2026](https://sportgearfinder.com/ski/helmets.html) — ASTM F2040 certification, what MIPS addresses, and goggle integration

## Interactive tools

- [Tennis Racket Finder](https://sportgearfinder.com/tools/tennis-racket-finder.html) — matches a racket to skill level, playing style and swing speed
- [Boxing Glove Size Calculator](https://sportgearfinder.com/tools/boxing-glove-size-calculator.html) — recommends glove oz from body weight and training type
- [Heavy Bag Weight Calculator](https://sportgearfinder.com/tools/heavy-bag-weight-calculator.html) — recommends bag weight from body weight
- [Gear Finder](https://sportgearfinder.com/) — asks a five-question profile (sport, level, budget, where you play, what you already own) and returns one pick per slot of a complete kit inside that budget, with the reason each pick suits that person

## Article library

75 long-form guides at [/articles/](https://sportgearfinder.com/articles/),
organised by sport. These go deeper on single questions than the category pages
— sizing problems, two-model comparisons, gear for specific conditions and
budget ceilings ("under $50", "under $1000").

## Notes

- [About](https://sportgearfinder.com/about.html) — who runs the site and how picks are chosen
- [Privacy](https://sportgearfinder.com/privacy.html) — analytics and cookie usage
- Site is static HTML; every page renders fully without JavaScript, so nothing
  in a guide is hidden behind client-side rendering.
- Product data is also machine-readable at
  [/data/products.json](https://sportgearfinder.com/data/products.json).
